note: Positive values mean more people arrived than left; negative values mean more people left than arrived.
title: Net migration to England and the United Kingdom as a share of the population
subtitle: Number of people moving to the country each year, minus the number leaving, as a share of its population. The brown line shows figures for England from 1541 to 1854; these estimates are reconstructed from church records. The orange line shows figures for the UK from 1855; these are based on passenger counts, surveys, and administrative records.
